data.title: Uber Exits Serve Robotics Stake as Delivery Alliance Unravels
data.description: Uber Technologies Inc. has divested from long-time partner Serve Robotics Inc. as the two companies clash over how to deploy delivery robots, the latest setback in Uber’s push to facilitate autonomous services on its platform.
